name: upset
turns: Thank you for calling Meridian Voice Support, this is Priya. How can I help you today?
Yeah, this is Frank Russo with Russo Plumbing. This is the third time I'm calling about this. Our phones keep dropping calls in the middle of conversations.
I'm sorry to hear that, Frank. Can I get the main number on the account?
Three one two, five five five, zero one nine zero. You should have all of this already. I've given it to you people twice.
I understand, and I apologize. I see the previous tickets here. Let me check the call logs for your line. Can you hold for a moment?
Thanks for holding, Frank. I'm looking at the logs, and I'm not seeing any errors on our side.
No errors? Calls are dropping every single day. My customers think we're hanging up on them.
I understand how frustrating that is. It could be something with the internet connection at your office. Have you been able to check with your internet provider?
My internet is fine. Everything else works. It's only your phones. Every time I call, someone tells me to check something else.
I'm sorry. I don't have a way to fix this from here today. I can escalate the ticket to our network team, and someone should call you back within one to two business days.
One to two days? I'm losing business right now. Can you at least credit us for the time this has been broken?
I'm not able to issue credits myself. I can add a note asking for one, but I can't promise it will be approved.
Unbelievable. Forget it. If this isn't fixed by Friday, we're switching providers.
I understand, Frank. I've escalated the ticket and noted your request for a credit. Again, I'm sorry for the trouble.

sipp_uas_upset.xml.title: Upset caller agent: one hold, can't fix it
